description: This is a C source file implementing a simple test utility for verifying VM-to-VM communication over virtio sockets (vsock). It contains functions for setting up a server and client mode, handling socket communication, and performing basic error checking. The program can run as a server listening on a specified port or as a client connecting to a specified CID and port, sending and receiving test strings.

methods.name: check_socket
methods.description: Checks if a socket descriptor is valid; prints error and exits if invalid.

methods.name: check_error
methods.description: Checks if an operation result indicates an error; prints message, closes socket if needed, and exits.

methods.name: main_server
methods.description: Sets up a vsock server that listens on a specified port, accepts a connection, reads data, and echoes it back.

methods.name: main_client
methods.description: Connects to a specified CID and port as a client, sends a string, and waits for the echoed response.
